atten2.ptxt: Some of these service operations affect the SRS airbag system, so be sure to read the precautions for the SRS airbag system before starting work. (see )

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.3

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 3 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws and remove steering wheel cover LWR No.3.

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 4 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove steering wheel cover LWR No.3.

s-1.ptxt: Remove Steering Wheel Cover Lower NO.2

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 3 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Disengage the 3 claws and remove steering wheel cover LWR No.2.

s2.ptxt: Steering Wheel Assembly 4 Spoke:

s3.ptxt: Disengage the 2 claws and remove steering wheel cover LWR No.2.

atten2.ptxt: When storing the horn button assembly, even temporarily, always keep the deployment surface facing up.

s2.ptxt: Make sure that the ignition switch is OFF.
Check that the battery negative terminal is disconnected.

atten2.ptxt: After disconnecting the battery negative terminal, do not start work for 90 seconds.

s2.ptxt: Using a flat-tip screwdriver, push in the 2 torsion springs shown in the illustration and disengage the 2 pins.

atten3.ptxt: Do not drop the horn button assembly.

s2.ptxt: Pull the horn button assembly toward the rear of the vehicle.

atten3.ptxt: Do not pull the wiring when pulling out the horn button assembly.

s2.ptxt: Using a thin flat-tip screwdriver wrapped with protective tape, pull up the lock of the airbag connector to release it.
Disconnect the airbag connector and horn connector, and remove the horn button assembly.
Operate the tilt and telescopic mechanisms to fix the steering column assembly in its fully extended and fully raised position.
Remove the nut and put matchmarks on the steering wheel assembly and steering column assembly.
Using SST, remove the steering wheel assembly.

atten3.ptxt: Apply a small amount of grease to the threads and tip of the SST center bolt (09953-05020) before use.

s2.ptxt: Disconnect the connector and disengage the clamp.
Remove the screw.
Disengage the 2 pins and claw, and separate the steering pad switch LH side from the steering wheel assembly.
Remove the screw.
Disengage the clamp.
Disengage the 2 pins and claw, detach the steering pad switch RH side from the steering wheel assembly, and remove the steering pad switch assembly.
Remove the 2 screws, disengage the 4 pins and detach the transmission shift switch.
From the back of the steering wheel assembly, disconnect the connector from the transmission shift switch.
Disengage the 4 guides and remove the transmission shift switch and switch wire NO.1.
